market.summary: India bounced back today: the Sensex gained about 1.2% and the Nifty about 1.0%, with far more stocks rising than falling. Realty and FMCG led, banks helped and autos were the only weak sector. Oil eased (Brent down to about $110 in late trade), which helps the consumer and hotel names you hold. US markets were softer this evening (Nasdaq -1.1%), so tomorrow's start may be quieter.

points.text: The Fed held its rate at 3.75-4.00%; Brent fell about 1.4% to near $114 by the Indian close.
Evening quotes: Brent $109.54 (-5.0%), S&P 500 -0.26%, Nasdaq -1.14%, US VIX 16.4, USD/INR 95.25.
Provisional flows 28 Oct: FIIs net buyers Rs 871.83 Cr, DIIs net buyers Rs 643.35 Cr (29 Oct figures not yet in).

market.watch: Oil staying near $110 or lower is good for hotels and consumer durables; watch whether US tech weakness carries into Asia tomorrow.

GROWW.summary: No new filing or company news today. Groww edged up 0.4% to 191.12 on an up day for the market, still just above the 188.75 stop. Selling pressure is low (accumulation days outnumber distribution days 5 to 1), but the stock has not regained the 200.80 entry since mid-October, so the trade is still about -0.8R.

points.text: Close Rs 191.12 vs entry Rs 200.80 and stop Rs 188.75: -0.80R (-4.8%); +1R is Rs 212.85.
Last exchange filing is still the 16 Oct call transcript; no bulk / block / short deals in the last 10 days.
Promoter trusts' pledge top-up with Aditya Birla Capital (disclosed 28 Oct) was covered this morning; nothing new since.

GROWW.watch: A close under 188.75 is the exit; a close back above 200.80 would put the trade back in profit.

SEJALLTD.summary: Sejal fell 6.4% to 820.75 today on about twice its usual volume while the market rose, and closed below both the 846.50 result-day low and the 838.03 stop. No exchange filing or news explains the fall (this check found none); it looks like stock-specific selling, as on 22 Oct when it also hit a lower circuit. On a closing basis the plan says exit.

points.text: Close Rs 820.75 (-6.4%) vs average Rs 884.13 and stop Rs 838.03: -1.37R (-7.2%). Volume 71,685 shares vs 33,827 the day before.
On 22 Oct the stock also locked a 10% lower circuit intraday (low Rs 778.45) with no company news cited.
No new filing since the 27 Oct call transcript; guidance reported after results was 25-40% FY27 revenue growth at ~18% EBITDA margin.

SEJALLTD.watch: The plan says exit below 838.03; tell Claude the exit price once sold so the trade moves to Closed trades.

THELEELA.summary: No new filing, but the price did the work: Leela jumped 5.7% to 639.90 on its heaviest volume in weeks (1.37 M shares) and closed near the day's high, crossing +1R (635.66). Under the plan the stop now moves up to cost, 604.51. Lower oil and a firm market helped hotels.

points.text: Close Rs 639.90 vs entry Rs 604.51: +1.14R (+5.9%); +1R Rs 635.66 reached, stop now at cost Rs 604.51 (21 / 63 EMA trail).
Volume 1,373,406 shares vs 1,005,944 the day before; 9 accumulation vs 2 distribution days in 25 sessions.
Last filing is the 22 Oct Q2 FY27 call transcript; nothing new since.

THELEELA.watch: Trail on a closing basis: stop at cost 604.51, then the 21 EMA; a close back under 635 would be a first warning.

INDHOTEL.summary: No new filing or news since the 28 Oct call transcript. Indian Hotels rose 0.6% to 810.00 on lighter volume, holding most of its post-result gains, about +0.5R. Accumulation still dominates and the stock is well above its 21 EMA (762.56).

points.text: Close Rs 810.00 vs entry Rs 785.83: +0.53R (+3.1%); stop Rs 740.47 until +1R at Rs 831.19.
Q2 FY27 call transcript filed 28 Oct; no bulk / block deals.

INDHOTEL.watch: +1R at 831.19 moves the stop to cost; the high so far is 812.85.

points.text: Close Rs 791.35 vs entry Rs 727.89: +0.96R (+8.7%); +1R Rs 793.67 was hit on 28 Oct (close 793.90), stop at cost Rs 727.89.
Volume 931,133 shares vs 1,647,467 on the breakout day; 7 accumulation vs 2 distribution days.

TIPSMUSIC.watch: Trail at cost / 21 EMA (715.42) on a closing basis.
